description_en: This topic describes lightweight database instances
description_zh: 查看轻量数据库实例信息
kebab_example: aliyun swas-open describe-database-instances --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --database-instance-ids swasdb-xxx000000_,_swasdb-yyy000000 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDatabaseInstances

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the lightweight database instances are located
parameters.help_zh: 指定的轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the lightweight database instances. The value is a JSON array that can contain up to 100 instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
轻量数据库实例ID。
取值可以由多个轻量数据库实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个实例ID，ID之间用英文半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: database_instance_ids

parameters.help_en:
The page number.

Pages start from page 1.

Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh:
轻量数据库实例列表的页码。

起始值：1

默认值：1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries per page.

Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时设置的每页行数。

最大值：100。

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

DatabaseInstances.description_en: The information about the Simple Application Server database instances
DatabaseInstances.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例集合信息

items.description_en: The details of a Simple Application Server database instance
items.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例集合信息

BusinessStatus.description_en:
The business status of the instance. Valid values:

`normal`: The instance is normal.

`expired`: The instance has expired.

`overdue`: The payment for the instance is overdue
BusinessStatus.description_zh:
业务状态。可能值：

normal: 正常。
expired: 到期。
overdue: 欠费

ChargeType.description_en:
The billing method of the instance. Only the subscription billing method is supported. The value is fixed as `PrePaid`.

Default value: `PrePaid`
ChargeType.description_zh:
轻量数据库例的计费方式。目前只支持包年包月的计费方式，取值为PrePaid。

默认值：PrePaid

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the instance was created. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC
CreationTime.description_zh: 实例创建时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ

DatabaseInstanceEdition.description_en:
The edition of the Simple Application Server database instance. Valid values:

`swas.db.c1m1s25`: 35 CNY/month.

`swas.db.c1m2s80`: 100 CNY/month.

`swas.db.c2m4s120`: 200 CNY/month.

`swas.db.c2m8s240`: 300 CNY/month
DatabaseInstanceEdition.description_zh:
轻量数据库实例套餐版本ID。可能值：

swas.db.c1m1s25：35元/月。

swas.db.c1m2s80：100元/月。

swas.db.c2m4s120：200元/月。
swas.db.c2m8s240：300元/月

DatabaseInstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Simple Application Server database instance

DatabaseInstanceName.description_en: The name of the Simple Application Server database instance

DatabaseInstanceStatus.description_en:
The status of the Simple Application Server database instance. Valid values:

`Pending`: The instance is being created.

`Restarting`: The instance is being restarted.

`Running`: The instance is running.

`Stopping`: The instance is being stopped.

`Stopped`: The instance is stopped.

`UPGRADING`: The instance is being upgraded.

`DISABLED`: The instance is disabled
DatabaseInstanceStatus.description_zh:
轻量数据库服务实例状态：可能值

Pending: 创建中。
Restarting：重启中。
Running：运行中。
Stopping：停止中。
Stopped：已停止。
UPGRADING：升级中。
DISABLED：已禁用

DatabaseVersion.description_en:
The database version. Valid values:

`5.7`: MySQL 5.7.

`8.0`: MySQL 8.0

ExpiredTime.description_en:
The time when the instance expires. The time follows the [ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html） standard in the `yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ` format. The time is displayed in UTC.

The expiration time displayed in the console is eight hours later than the UTC time
ExpiredTime.description_zh:
实例到期时间。按照[ISO 8601]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25696.html）标准表示，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

+8小时后是控制台上显示的到期时间

PublicConnection.description_en:
The public connection endpoint.

This parameter is returned only if a public endpoint is enabled for the instance. You can call the [AllocatePublicConnection]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451413.html） operation to enable a public endpoint
PublicConnection.description_zh:
公网链接地址。

只有申请开通公网访问地址才显示此参数。您可以调用[AllocatePublicConnection]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/451413.html）申请外网地址

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the Simple Application Server database instance
RegionId.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例所属的地域ID

Storage.description_en: The disk space of the ESSD. Unit: GB

SuperAccountName.description_en: The name of the privileged account of the Simple Application Server database instance
SuperAccountName.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例超级账号名称

PageNumber.description_en: The number of entries per page
PageNumber.description_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数

PageSize.description_en: The page number of the returned page
PageSize.description_zh: 轻量数据库实例列表的当前页码

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
